data.name: Matthias
data.gender_notes: Matthias is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, the name Matthias means 'gift of God'. In Greek, it is derived from the Hebrew name Mattiyah, which means 'gift of Yahweh'. In the New Testament, Matthias is one of the twelve apostles chosen to replace Judas Iscariot. Matthias was chosen because he was numbered among the believers in Jerusalem and was recognized as having a virtuous character.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes God's divine intervention and selection in our lives.
data.etymology: Matthias belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Matthias total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: מתתias
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מתתias הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'מתנה מאלוהים' או 'משיח האל'. השם מתתias הוא צורה עברית של השם היווני Μαθθίας (Maththias), שמקורו בשם העברי מתתיהו (Mattithyahu). השם מתתיהו מורכב מהמילים 'מתת' (מתנה) ו'יהו' (אלוהים). השם מתתias נמצא בברית החדשה של התנך, בספר מעשים של השליחים, פרק א', פסוקים 21-26, שם הוא מוזכר כאחד מהשליחים שנבחרו להחליף את יהודה איש קריות.

in_greek.name: Μαθθίας
in_greek.long_meaning: Μαθθίας (Maththias) είναι το ελληνικό ισοδύναμο του εβραϊκού ονόματος מתתיהו (Mattithyahu), που σημαίνει 'δωρεὰ παρὰ θεοῦ' (δώρημα από τον Θεό) ή 'χρηστός του Θεοῦ' (εκλεκτός του Θεοῦ). Το όνομα Μαθθίας αναφέρεται στη Καινή Διαθήκη, στο βιβλίο των Πράξεων των Αποστόλων, κεφάλαιο 1, εδάφια 21-26, όπου ο Μαθθίας επιλέγεται ως ένας από τους αποστόλους για να αντικαταστήσει τον Ιούδα Ισκαριώτη.

in_latin.name: Matthias
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Matthias origine hebraicum est, quod interpretatur 'donum Dei' vel 'electus Dei'. In Ecclesia primitiva, Matthias fuit unus ex apostolis qui electus est ad supplendum locum Iudae Iscariotae, secundum Actus Apostolorum, caput 1, versiculi 21-26. Nomen Matthias in traditione christiana significat gratiam et benedictionem divinam.

in_english.name: Matthias
in_english.meaning: Gift of God, or chosen by God
in_english.long_meaning: The name Matthias originates from the Hebrew name מתתיהו (Mattithyahu), which means 'gift of God' or 'chosen by God'. In the New Testament, Matthias is chosen as one of the apostles to replace Judas Iscariot, as recorded in Acts 1:21-26. The name has been used in Christian tradition to signify divine favor and blessing. Throughout history, the name Matthias has been popular among Christians, symbolizing spiritual gifts and divine election.

data.spiritual_significance: Matthias is a spiritual name that symbolizes the idea of being a gift from God. It reminds us that each person has a unique purpose in life, and that we are all given to the world as gifts from the divine. The name Matthias also signifies virtue and faithfulness, qualities that are highly valued in spiritual traditions.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Matthias, meaning "gift of God," underscores the belief that every individual is a divine gift, entrusted with purpose and potential. This name is a reminder of God's grace and goodness in bestowing each person with unique abilities and talents.
